description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to managing bootstrap file size budgets, including analysis, warnings, signatures, and truncation reports for bootstrap files in a workspace.

methods.name: normalizePositiveLimit
methods.description: Ensures a positive limit value, defaulting to 1 if input is invalid or non-positive.

methods.name: formatWarningCause
methods.description: Converts a BootstrapTruncationCause to a string representation.

methods.name: normalizeSeenSignatures
methods.description: Normalizes an array of signature strings, removing duplicates and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: appendSeenSignature
methods.description: Adds a signature to the list of seen signatures, maintaining a maximum history size.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapWarningSignaturesSeen
methods.description: Determines which warning signatures have been seen based on report data and mode.

methods.name: buildBootstrapInjectionStats
methods.description: Builds stats for bootstrap files based on injected files and their content.

methods.name: analyzeBootstrapBudget
methods.description: Analyzes bootstrap file sizes against configured limits, identifying truncation and near-limit files.

methods.name: buildBootstrapTruncationSignature
methods.description: Creates a JSON string signature representing truncated bootstrap files.

methods.name: formatBootstrapTruncationWarningLines
methods.description: Generates warning lines for truncated bootstrap files, including file details and suggestions.

methods.name: buildBootstrapPromptWarning
methods.description: Constructs a warning object for bootstrap truncation, including signature and display lines.

methods.name: appendBootstrapPromptWarning
methods.description: Appends bootstrap truncation warnings to an existing prompt message.

methods.name: buildBootstrapTruncationReportMeta
methods.description: Creates metadata summarizing bootstrap truncation warning state and analysis.
